g.text: Human Secure Socket Host — Consent-Driven Personal Intelligence. Your data. Your agents. Yours to own.
Read down: ① decode the words · ② the platform (what it is) · ③ end-to-end flows (how every story connects). [LIGHT MODE]
— every acronym in plain English (decode FIRST, then read the map)
Personal Knowledge Model — your encrypted memory
Bring Your Own Key — only you hold it
Model Context Protocol — the AI tool bridge
Merchant of Record — business keeps it
priced consent — value to the user
one person's own Cloud Run service — their agent's home
the opaque per-person identifier a pod is named for
the pod's identity holds NO project permissions
unreachable from the internet; the hub is the only door
the renewed least-privilege grant a pod turn runs on
CPU held between requests, or scale-to-zero
— what it is. Eight layers; each card shows the name, its generic role (tag), then what · why · how · e.g. Read top → down.
— where a person or an AI meets Hussh — web, native, on-device, external hosts
browser app on shared React shell
the surfaces reach people through governed channels …
— governed ways results & capabilities reach users, devs, partners
channels open the agent-economy where brands transact …
— the value-inversion layer — brands' agents bid; money flows to the user
PCHP bid + AP2 settle · Nav reserve
every transaction is driven by agents that …
— reason, debate, delegate & act inside scoped authority — never raw keys
the top private agent, running in the owner's OWN pod
one mind that coordinates — on compute the person owns, not a shared
Listen·Remember·Decide·Act · thinks on the owner's AI key, never a
act on scoped memory provided by …
— the heart: one encrypted store the user truly owns (zero-knowledge)
the encrypted PKM, whose every read/write is gated by …
— every action proves identity & earns consent first — the gate
the trust & consent layer, enforced through …
— the backend that enforces policy & brings chosen data in
core platform services, all running on the infrastructure foundation.
— the governed foundation everything above runs on
one Cloud Run service per person
your agent runs on compute that is yours, not a shared
internal ingress · no allUsers · zero-role SA · 500m/1Gi
· warm tier keeps CPU between requests
a pod nobody watches is a pod nobody can trust
pod beats → hub pulls its key · stalled rows retried ·
project sharded before the region cap
— how it connects. Each story is ONE left → right sequence of real steps. Lanes never cross.
FSC updated — never a PKM mirror
Choose your AI — managed or your own key
Verify it with a real generation — no key, no pod
Create one-pod-<HusshID> · zero-role SA · internal only
Pod boots · first heartbeat says it is up
Hub pulls the pod's public key · mints standing pkm.read
Turn runs INSIDE the pod, on the owner's own key
Greenfield (future): ② AI-memory import · ③ public-profile→PKM · ④ broker execution · ⑥ FSC/MuleSoft · ⑨ on-device edge · ⑪ UCP+AP2 commerce · ⑫ consent reverse-auction.
Grounded in: hushh-research/docs · hussh-dev-platform (PCHP spec v1.1) · hushh-ria-intelligence-api · UCP (ucp.dev) · AP2 (ap2-protocol.org). Status is honest, not aspirational.
